messages:
Chloe (writer): Quick question — my docs-only PR is stuck, GitHub shows a required check failing (ci/docs-preview). I thought docs PRs auto-merge once checks pass? :thinking:
Priya K (docs): Hey! We do auto-merge for docs-only PRs, but the rule depends on branch-protection + required checks configured. What check is failing? :eyes:
docs-ci-bot: ci/docs-preview — failed 
  Details: linkcheck found 3 broken links in docs/getting-started.md. Full report: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/8421
Chloe (writer): Ah ok — linkcheck. That report is noisy and sometimes external site flakiness blocks merges. Is there a way to bypass this for docs-only updates that only touch prose/examples?
Sam R (platform): We try not to bypass checks, but we can make linkcheck less strict for auto-merge eligibility. Right now auto-merge requires: 1) all required status checks green, 2) CODEOWNERS approvals satisfied, 3) no merge conflicts. If linkcheck is flaky we can either: a) exempt linkcheck from the required checks, or b) add a label that tells the bot to ignore linkcheck for docs-only PRs.
Priya K (docs): Prefer option (b) — keep linkcheck as a required check for most PRs but allow `docs-bot` to skip it when the PR is docs-only and maintainer-approved. That keeps safety for code changes.
Jasper (infra): Implementation notes: GitHub branch protection can't be conditional, so auto-merge bot has to enforce rules. We can change our auto-merge workflow to treat `ci/docs-preview/linkcheck` as advisory if PR paths match `docs/**` and label `skip-linkcheck` is present (or `docs-only` label). Example pseudo-check in GH action:```yaml
if: github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name contains 'docs-only' && failure() == 'linkcheck'
# then mark as advisory for auto-merge
```
Chloe (writer): Who can add the `docs-only` label? CODEOWNERS auto-request reviewers, but labels are manual — I don't want to ping maintainers every time. Could a workflow add the label automatically for pure docs diffs?
Priya K (docs): Yes — we already run a tiny action that sets `docs-only` if the PR diff only touches `/docs/` and markdown files. It was disabled because of a bug, but we can re-enable and then have the auto-merge action trust that label.
Sam R (platform): Two cautions: 1) attack vector — label automation must ensure base branch is protected and PR author isn't the only approver; 2) CODEOWNERS still triggers required reviews and those must be present. The auto-merge bot cannot bypass branch-protection required approvals.
Jasper (infra): On CODEOWNERS — current file has this:```text
/docs/**  @redwood/docs @redwood/devex
/sdk/**   @redwood/sdk
/**       @redwood/platform
```
If a docs PR touches `/sdk/snippets` we sometimes get platform owners too. That delays merges. We could scope CODEOWNERS more narrowly to avoid extra reviewers for small docs edits.
Priya K (docs): Agreed — propose we move `@redwood/platform` to only own `ops/**` and keep `/docs/**` owned by `@redwood/docs`. That should reduce accidental reviewer pinging. I'll open a tiny PR to update CODEOWNERS.
Chloe (writer): Nice. For the immediate PR, any quick workaround so I don't have to wait for infra changes?
Sam R (platform): Short-term: add the `docs-only` label (I'll do it) and ask a CODEOWNER from `@redwood/docs` to approve. Once approval is present and other required checks (except linkcheck) are green, I'll trigger the auto-merge manually using the merge queue bot.
Chloe (writer): Thanks — @Sam R appreciate it. If we need the linkcheck fix later, I can follow up on the three broken links reported. One is an internal path that I can patch now.
docs-ci-bot: ci/docs-preview — new run queued after latest push. Passing: build, lint. Failing: linkcheck (2 broken links remaining).
Priya K (docs): After CODEOWNERS update and re-enable `docs-only` automation, proposed flow: - docs-only label auto-added - linkcheck stays required but auto-merge action treats it as advisory when label present and a human CODEOWNER approved - auto-merge still needs at least one CODEOWNER approval (no single-author bypass)
Jasper (infra): Sounds reasonable. I'll draft the change to auto-merge workflow (should be a ~20-line change) and run it behind a feature flag. Will tag infra/docs for review.
Chloe (writer): Great — for now I pushed a tiny fix to the broken internal link. CI shows linkcheck is down to 0 failures. Thanks everyone :tada:
Sam R (platform): Approved and queued for merge. :+1:
Chloe (writer): Merged. :party_parrot:
